V2 is paper/shadow/observer only. V2 writes zero v2:* Redis keys. Multiple V2 files self-declare MISSING_IN_V2, FAIL_CLOSED_STUB, or PAPER_ONLY. Legacy shutdown is structurally NO-GO until V2 owns production-equivalent runtime, regardless of any paper-only operator acceptance file.
